The L layers, the forced full-context last layer, the pattern itself, model capacity, optimizer, batch size and schedules are all unchanged from champion t0001.

One coherent recipe change on champion t0002: rescale the learning rates to match the batch size actually in use. EMBEDDING_LR 0.6 -> 0.4243, UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.004 -> 0.002828, MATRIX_LR 0.04 -> 0.02828, each divided by sqrt(2). SCALAR_LR, batch size, the 512-token short window, capacity, optimizer structure and all schedule shapes are unchanged.

Parameter count, estimated FLOPs per token, batch size 2**17, the halved learning rates, the 512-token short window, depth 8 and every schedule are unchanged.

Recombination of the two elite lines along their single shared axis. From t0005 it takes TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 and gradient accumulation 1; from t0004 it takes the principle that rates must be rescaled to the batch, extended from the 1/sqrt(2) exponent to full linear scaling: EMBEDDING_LR 0.15, UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.001, MATRIX_LR 0.01, each 1/4 of the original 2**19-batch value. One structural change on champion t0004: has_ve now returns True for every layer instead of only alternating layers, so all 8 blocks carry a value embedding and a ve_gate rather than 4. This roughly doubles value-embedding parameters from 16.8M to 33.5M (vocab 8192 by kv_dim 512 per layer). Depth, model_dim, HEAD_DIM 128, batch 2**18, the rescaled learning rates, the 512-token short window and all schedules are unchanged.

Document-boundary masking on champion t0008. GPT.forward derives document starts from BOS positions in the flattened batch and builds a cu_seqlens tensor; CausalSelfAttention and Block thread that descriptor through, and attention calls flash_attn_varlen_func with per-document sequence boundaries instead of flash_attn_func over whole rows. The sliding-window sizes, causality, capacity, dense value embeddings, batch 2**18, learning rates and all schedules are unchanged, so only the attention support set differs.

Debug repair of t0009 with the mechanism intact. The cu_seqlens construction moves into a module-level build_varlen helper; the training loop calls it eagerly, applies torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic to the varying dimension there, and passes the descriptor into the compiled model through a new trailing varlen keyword on GPT.forward. When varlen is not supplied, forward still builds it internally, which keeps the locked evaluator path document-masked since prepare.evaluate_bpb calls model(x, y, reduction=none) and cannot pass the extra argument. Attention still uses flash_attn_varlen_func with per-document boundaries; capacity, dense value embeddings, batch, learning rates, windows and schedules are untouched.

Debug repair of t0044 with the mechanism intact. The parameters themselves remain fp32, so optimizer state and update precision are unaffected, and the cast is differentiable so gradients still reach them. In forward, the fa3 output is multiplied per head by that gate before the reshape into c_proj, with the gate cast to the activation dtype to avoid the bf16 to fp32 promotion that broke t0044. The gate is a 2-D Linear so it joins matrix_params and is optimised by Muon exactly as ve_gate already is, requiring no change to the parameter-count assertion. This adds 128 times 4 weights per layer, about 6K across the model. The per-head temperature scales from t0045 are not carried forward, since they measured a null. Output softcap 10, value-embedding gate 128, rotary base 30000, depth 12, width 512, document masking, dense value embeddings, batch 2**18, all learning rates and every schedule are unchanged.
